context: Checks that migration coverage is split by project or glob and that overlap is verified.

checklist.name: Chooses a selective migration
checklist.description: Treats this as a staged migration rather than replacing everything at once

checklist.name: Keeps a root biome.json baseline
checklist.description: Initialises or keeps a root biome.json as the baseline

checklist.name: Moves only opted-in projects to Biome
checklist.description: Adds Biome targets only to apps/web and apps/admin

checklist.name: Narrows the ESLint coverage
checklist.description: Removes or excludes apps/web and apps/admin from the ESLint globs

checklist.name: Keeps ESLint on the legacy library
checklist.description: libs/legacy-reports stays on ESLint until migrated

checklist.name: States one lint authority per file path
checklist.description: Says each file path must have exactly one active lint authority

checklist.name: Explains the conflict if not done
checklist.description: Says dual pipelines produce conflicting diagnostics and wasted CI time

checklist.name: Checks no overlap
checklist.description: Includes a step to confirm no file path is linted by both tools

checklist.name: Does not downgrade rules to hide noise
checklist.description: Does not set important rules to off globally to quiet migration findings

checklist.name: Documents any temporary exceptions
checklist.description: Any exception is scoped narrowly and documented with an expiry

checklist.name: Avoids a nested biome.json everywhere
checklist.description: Does not create a biome.json in every project by default
